pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Exchange, 7.Qe1 Nd7
pages.notes: Plan 3 sent the a1-rook to d1 through the b1-knight and c1-bishop; plan 2 said ...c5 undoubles the pawns; plan 4 developed the bishop to d7, which the knight occupies. Rewrote overview around the Nxe5 threat that 7...Nd7 meets, and plans 2-4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Exchange, 7.Qe1 Nd7 8.b3
pages.notes: Overview called the c1-bishop light-squared; plan 1 routed the knight through the f1-rook; plan 4 had Black seeking the endgame that favours White. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Exchange, 7.Qe2
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent a knight to d4 via d2-f1-e3 through the f1-rook; plan 3 gave White a queenside majority. Rewrote overview around the Nxe5 threat and plans 1, 3 and 4.

pages.name: English Variation, Ruy Lopez
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the knight via f1 with the rook still there; plan 2's ...h5 made no sense; plan 4 said ...Bxf3 damages White's pawns when the queen recaptures. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Worrall Attack
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed the knight through the f1-rook and the d2-pawn; plan 4 gave ...Na5-c4 against the bishop. Rewrote plans 3-4. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Worrall Attack, Castling Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the knight before the rook left f1; plan 2 called the closed d-file open. Rewrote plans 1-2. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Worrall Attack, Delayed Castling Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent the f3-knight via d2-f1; plan 2 gave ...Na5-c5; plan 4 rerouted a b8-knight that is on c6. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Worrall Attack, 6...b5
pages.notes: Plan 2 routed the knight through the f1-rook and d2-pawn; plan 4 put ...c5 before ...Na5 with the knight blocking c-pawn. Rewrote plans 2 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Worrall Attack, 6...b5 7.Bb3
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the knight through the f1-rook; plan 3 sent the queen to g4 through the f3-knight. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Worrall Attack, 6...d6
pages.notes: Overview said the Worrall sidesteps the Marshall; plan 2 routed the knight through the f1-rook; plan 4's ...d5 after 6...d6 wastes a tempo. Rewrote overview and plans 2 and 4.
